Import Data

Supports .csv, .xlsx from Center IC and .ics calendar exports

How to export a calendar (.ics) from Outlook

1. In Outlook, go to File → Open & Export → Import/Export

2. Choose "Export to a file", click Next

3. Select "iCalendar format (.ics)"

4. Pick the calendar you want to export, set the date range, and save

5. Drag the saved .ics file onto this page

Tip: Export one month at a time for the fastest review. The tracker will auto-detect VBRC events and skip personal items.
